title: Club Car Inc. Recalls Golf Cars and Other Vehicles; Mechanical Failure Can Result in Loss of Steering Control
summary: The steering gear assembly can fail, resulting in an unexpected loss of steering control, posing a risk of injury to the driver and passenger. Units: About 1,900.

title: LED Lights Recalled by Plan 9 Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The circuit board in the lights can overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 340.

title: Raleigh America Recalls Bicycles; Forks Can Break Causing Loss of Control
summary: The forks can break during normal use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 1,200.

title: Rehvac Manufacturing Recalls Safety Relief Plugs Due to Injury Hazard; Plugs Used on Nitrous Oxide Systems and Heating and Air Conditioning Service Tools
summary: The safety relief plug can allow pressure to build in the cylinder of an HVAC pressure testing tool or Nitrous Oxide system. If the cylinder is overfilled and overheated, it can burst, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,700.

title: Sandal Clogs Recalled by Hanna Andersson Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The leather ankle strap can tear or separate from the clog sole, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,900.

title: Serious Facial Injury from Explosion of Aerosol Can Prompts Sherwin-Williams Recall; Firm Warns Consumers Not to Handle Hi-Heat™ Coating Cans
summary: The aerosol cans can over-pressurize and explode, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: The Orvis Company Recalls Children's Toys Sold with Sleeping Bags Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic button eyes on the stuffed horse and the pompom nose on the fairy doll toy can easily detach, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 220 Horses and 1,300 Fairy Dolls.

title: Trane CleanEffects™ and American Standard AccuClean™ Air Filtration Systems Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical arcing inside the collection cells can cause the collection cell material to overheat or ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 135,000.

title: Window Blinds Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores Recalled for Repair by Springs Window Fashions Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The window blinds have a pull cord that is looped, posing a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 140,000.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Licensed Character Toys Due To Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: Surface paints on the toys could contain excessive levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 967,000.

title: Clarion Expands Recall of Vehicle Navigation and Entertainment System Batteries Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in these units can melt or overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 1,500 additional units (This recall was first announced in Dec. 2006).

title: Giftco Inc. Recalls Pine Cone Candle Sets Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candles' exterior paint and coating can ignite and catch fire, igniting nearby combustibles. Units: About 24,000.

title: International Home Fashions and Bilt-Safe Technologies Recall "Classic Beautyrest" Electric Throws Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Bunching, folding or tucking of these electric throws can cause them to overheat, resulting in smoldering, melting, fire and burn hazards. Units: About 37,100.

title: Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Recalls Skil® Circular Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The trigger switch on the circular saw can be locked on or the switch can be turned on without the use of the safety lock-out. This can cause unexpected operation of the saw, posing a risk of laceration. Units: About 811,000.

title: Additional Reports of Magnets Detaching from Polly Pocket Play Sets Prompts Expanded Recall by Mattel
summary: Small magnets inside the dolls and accessories can come loose. The magnets can be found by young children and swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 7.3 million pl

title: Mattel Recalls "Sarge" Die Cast Toy Cars Due To Violation of Lead Safety Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys could contain lead levels in excess of federal standards. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 253,000.

title: Mattel Recalls Barbie and Tanner™ Magnetic Toys Due to Magnets Coming Loose
summary: A small magnet inside the "scooper" accessory can come loose. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 683,000.

title: Mattel Recalls Batman™ and One Piece™ Magnetic Action Figure Sets Due To Magnets Coming Loose
summary: Small, powerful magnets inside the accessories of the toy figures can fall out and be swallowed or aspirated by young children. If more than one magnet is swallowed, they can attract inside the body and cause intestinal perforation, infection or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 345,000.

title: Mattel Recalls Doggie Day Care™ Magnetic Toys Due to Magnets Coming Loose
summary: Small magnets inside the toys can fall out. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 1 million.

title: Eastern Illini Electric Cooperative Recalls Junction Boxes for Fire Hazard
summary: Wiring connections within the junction box can become loose, posing an overheating and fire hazard. Units: About 2,800.

title: Formation Inc. Recalls Coca-Cola® Themed Drinking Glasses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The inner wall of the double-walled glasses can break easily, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 300.

title: Outdoor Lounge Chairs Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs can collapse due to faulty rivets, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Toshiba Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Metal Folding Chairs Sold at Cost Plus World Market Stores Recalled Due to Collapse and Fall Hazards
summary: The chairs can collapse due to faulty rivets, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,500.

title: Stübben Steeltec Horseback Riding Stirrups Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stirrup's hinges can break, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 500.

title: B&F System Inc. Recalls Emergency Tool Kits Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: Booster cables in the recalled kits can have undersized wiring and inadequate connections, posing a fire and shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 43,000.

title: Berko Electric Toe-Space Heaters Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: If the fan stops working and the heater continues to run, the unit can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 84,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 400.

title: Electric Heaters Recalled by Aloha Housewares Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heater can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 281,000.

title: Toys "R" Us Recalls Wooden Coloring Cases Due To Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The printed ink on the outer packaging of the wood case contains lead. Also, some of the black watercolor paint contains excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 27,000.

title: Gerber Legendary Blades Recalls Pocket Knives
summary: During use, the back of the blade of the knife can slide past the blade support, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 154,000.

title: M&J Engineering Recalls Swivels for Scuba Diving Masks Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The swivel, which is attached to a diving mask, could separate while diving. This will result in a sudden loss of the diver's air supply, causing the diver to engage in emergency ascent. This poses a risk of decompression sickness due to rapid ascent or drowning. Units: About 1,500.

title: Paramount Apparel International Recalls Youth Hats Due to Strangulation Hazard; Product Sold Exclusively at Bass Pro Shops
summary: The hat has a drawstring, posing a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Sam's Club Recalls Outdoor Torch Lamps Due to Fire, Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The ceramic torch head can come loose or be dislodged during use, allowing it to break and spill torch fuel. This poses a risk of cuts, fire or burn injuries and property damage. Units: About 138,000.

title: Weather Radios Recalled by Oregon Scientific Due to Failure to Receive National Weather Service Alerts
summary: The radios could fail to receive National Weather Service alert signals in certain areas of the country. In the event of severe weather, this failure could put a consumer's life and property at risk. Units: About 66,000.

title: Children's Watering Cans Sold Exclusively at Jo-Ann Fabric and Craft Stores Recalled Due to Violation of Lead in Paint Ban
summary: The beak of the watering can contains lead in the paint, which violates the federal law prohibiting lead paint on children's toys. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 6,000.

title: Wolverine Recalls Caterpillar Logger Boots; Can Pose Shock Hazard To User Due to Mislabeling
summary: The recalled logger boots could be incorrectly labeled as resistant to electrical current. This poses a shock hazard to consumers who come in contact with an electrical current. Units: About 9,500.

title: Calligaris USA Recalls Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat on the bar stools can detach, causing the consumer to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 400.

title: Shindaiwa Inc. Announces Recall of Backpack Blowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The muffler's outer shell can melt allowing exhaust gas to exit from the bottom or back side of the muffler. The exhaust gas may cause damage to the fuel tank creating a possible fire hazard for the user. Units: About 22,000.

title: AC Adapters Sold With Network Hard Drives Recalled by I-O Data Device USA Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The AC adapters can overheat or melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 740.

title: Basic Editions Girls' Clothing Sets Recalled by Kmart; Drawstrings at Waist Pose Entrapment Hazard
summary: The recalled shirts have drawstrings at the waist. Children can get entangled or caught in a vehicle door and can be dragged, posing a serious risk of injury or death. Units: About 4,700.

title: CPSC, Stokke Announce Recall of Sleepi Crib Foam Mattresses Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The crib mattresses are not properly sized, creating a gap, posing an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: J.C. Penney Recalls Spindle-Back Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The wood stretchers can split while in use and the chairs can collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,000.

title: Priddy "Trucks" Shaker Teether Books Recalled Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Small pieces of the teether can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 35,000.

title: Children's Charm Bracelets Sold by Buy-Rite Recalled Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 7,900.

title: Children's Metal Jewelry Recalled by TOBY N.Y.C. Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled metal jewelry sets contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 14,000.

title: Martin Designs Inc. Recalls SpongeBob SquarePants™ Character Address Books and Journals Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the metal spiral bindings of the address books and journals can contain excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 250,000.

title: Thomas and Friends, Curious George and Other Spinning Tops and Tin Pails Recalled By Schylling Associates Due To Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the wooden handles of the tops and pails contain excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 66,000 spinning tops and about 4,700 pails.

title: Hampton Direct Recalls Magnetic Toy Train Sets Due to Lead Exposure Risk
summary: The paint on the trains contains excessive amounts of lead, posing a risk of lead exposure to young children. Units: About 27,000.
